milestones.title: Formal Language Semantics
milestones.implemented: Scalar semantics v1, 16 machine-readable rules, 52 authored cases and per-pass cross-engine conformance.
milestones.acceptance: Versioned semantics governs values, first faults, spans, visible effects and resource-policy exceptions; generated conformance covers each supported rule.

milestones.title: Multi-Level Intermediate Representation
milestones.implemented: AST, typed CFG, pruned SSA and block-local machine IR; no distinct typed HIR yet.
milestones.acceptance: Useful HIR/MIR/SSA/machine boundaries carry types, identities and source metadata; each lowering has a verifier and inspectable snapshots.

milestones.title: Advanced Compiler Analysis Framework
milestones.implemented: CFG/dominators/frontiers, finite-exit postdominance, SCC/loop forest, phi-aware def-use/liveness and checked analysis preservation. Conservative checked integer intervals with bounded widening.
milestones.acceptance: Required analyses are bounded, reusable and correctly invalidated; independent graph/dataflow oracles check results.

milestones.title: Effect-Aware Optimization Semantics
milestones.implemented: Transitive scalar call effects, trap/divergence summaries, conservative recursion/cycles and removal of unused proven-total calls. Integer range proofs authorize safe checked arithmetic removal.
milestones.acceptance: Elimination and motion preserve memory/host effects, trap order and documented fuel policy with explicit function summaries.

milestones.title: Hardened IR & Bytecode Verification
milestones.implemented: IR/bytecode verification, canonical bounded portable modules, hardened IR snapshot reader and sixth fuzzer.
milestones.acceptance: Malformed IR, bytecode, regions, references and sizes fail validation before execution across mutation/fuzz suites.

milestones.title: Transactional Optimization Pipeline
milestones.implemented: Per-pass candidate transactions, canonical snapshots, fingerprints, structural diffs, failure records and isolated production-pass replay.
milestones.acceptance: Every failed transformation has verified input, candidate, structural changes, isolated replay and an automatically minimized reproducer.

milestones.title: Strings, Arrays & Memory-Safe Collections
milestones.acceptance: UTF-8 strings, checked mutable/immutable arrays and views agree across AST/VM/JIT, with explicit aliasing, lifetime and allocation failure semantics.

milestones.title: Structs, Tuples & Algebraic Data Types
milestones.acceptance: Structures, tuples and ADTs have verified layout/alignment/initialization rules and a documented calling ABI.

milestones.title: Advanced Type System & Generics
milestones.acceptance: Constraints and monomorphization are bounded, deterministic and cached; cyclic instantiation has actionable diagnostics.

milestones.title: Pattern Matching & Exhaustiveness Checking
milestones.acceptance: Pattern matching checks exhaustiveness and unreachable arms and lowers to verified decision trees.

milestones.title: Closures & First-Class Functions
milestones.acceptance: Closures preserve capture/escape/lifetime semantics across frames, heap and all supported execution engines.

milestones.title: Structured Error & Exception Model
milestones.acceptance: Result propagation and cleanup execute exactly once; language errors remain separate from runtime failures.

milestones.title: Modules, Packages & Visibility
milestones.implemented: Root-confined imports, export visibility, dependency DAG, overlays and exact in-memory file/interface caching.
milestones.acceptance: Reexports, visibility, interface changes, cycles and API compatibility drive correct incremental package compilation.

milestones.title: Async Functions & Coroutine Lowering
milestones.acceptance: Await lowers to coroutine states with bounded scheduling, cancellation, reentrancy and exactly-once cleanup.

milestones.title: Memory SSA & Advanced Alias Analysis
milestones.acceptance: Memory SSA and alias summaries preserve heap reads/writes across CFG and unknown calls.

milestones.title: Global Value Numbering & Partial Redundancy Elimination
milestones.acceptance: GVN/PRE/DSE/jump threading/range-based simplification preserve checked traps and show measured effects.

milestones.title: Advanced Loop Optimization
milestones.acceptance: Loop canonicalization, LICM and induction/bounds optimizations have explicit safety proofs and regression programs.

milestones.title: Interprocedural Optimization
milestones.acceptance: Inlining/specialization and call-graph optimization preserve effects and resource policy under code-size budgets.

milestones.title: Instruction Selection & Scheduling
milestones.implemented: Own x64 emitter and verified block-local machine IR; no general target description/legalizer.
milestones.acceptance: Target descriptions, legalization and instruction selection express register/ABI constraints without hardcoded frontend assumptions.

milestones.title: Global Register Allocation
milestones.implemented: Basic-block R8-R11 cache with next-use spilling and copy coalescing; no global allocation.
milestones.acceptance: Global linear scan and graph coloring handle liveness, parallel copies, spill costs and both x64 ABIs under register pressure.

milestones.title: Vectorization & SIMD
milestones.acceptance: Vectorization is enabled only under proved dependency/checked-arithmetic conditions; ISA-specific results are benchmarked.

milestones.title: Profile-Guided Optimization
milestones.acceptance: Profiles bind to exact build fingerprints and guide reproducible placement/specialization/inlining with measured overhead.

milestones.title: Link-Time & Whole-Program Optimization
milestones.acceptance: Whole-program summaries and linker-visible symbols support verified intermodule optimization without loading every body.

milestones.title: Managed Heap & Garbage Collector
milestones.acceptance: A traced managed heap supports roots, stable handles, baseline collection, moving collection and later generations/barriers with stress tests.

milestones.title: Safepoints, Stack Maps & Runtime Coordination
milestones.acceptance: Safepoints and stack/register maps identify every live reference across nested calls, GC, cancellation and tier transitions.

milestones.title: Tiered JIT & Adaptive Compilation
milestones.implemented: VM and x64 JIT with a hotness threshold; no optimizing tier, deoptimization or OSR.
milestones.acceptance: Baseline/optimizing tiers, guarded assumptions, OSR and deoptimization restore correct logical execution state.

milestones.title: Enterprise-Grade FFI & Embedding
milestones.implemented: One-way typed C/C++ and .NET embedding with reusable bounded contexts; no registered host callbacks.
milestones.acceptance: Bidirectional typed callbacks safely marshal objects and lifetimes with reentrancy, thread attachment and capabilities.

milestones.title: Sandboxed Execution & Secure JIT
milestones.implemented: Bytecode verification, execution budgets and W^X; no isolated worker process.
milestones.acceptance: Threat model distinguishes in-process JIT from process isolation; all exposed budgets and capability boundaries are tested.

milestones.title: Bytecode Format 2.0 & Compatibility
milestones.implemented: Canonical MPLXB 1.0 scalar format and compatibility checks; format 2.0 is future work.
milestones.acceptance: Versioned type/constant/symbol/import/debug/relocation sections have canonical bounded encoding and explicit compatibility policy.

milestones.title: Concurrency Runtime & Memory Model
milestones.acceptance: Isolated tasks, cancellation, channels/backpressure and documented memory ordering pass deterministic concurrency and race tests.

milestones.title: Demand-Driven Compiler Query Engine
milestones.implemented: Exact file/interface memoization in workspace compilation; not a general compiler query graph.
milestones.acceptance: Demand queries record dependencies, diagnose cycles and explain function-level red/green invalidation.

milestones.title: Persistent Content-Addressable Compiler Cache
milestones.acceptance: Persistent content-addressed artifacts survive corruption and concurrent processes using complete version/ABI/target keys and atomic writes.

milestones.title: Object Modules, Relocations & Linking
milestones.acceptance: Separately compiled object modules link reproducibly with symbol conflicts, imports/exports and relocation bounds checked.

milestones.title: Parallel & Incremental Compilation
milestones.acceptance: Worker counts 1/2/4/8/16 produce identical artifacts with bounded memory and cancellation-safe scheduling.

milestones.title: Advanced Language Server 2.0
milestones.implemented: Compiler-backed semantic LSP with cross-file definitions/references/rename and workspace overlays.
milestones.acceptance: Error-tolerant incremental snapshots support unfinished code, hierarchy/actions/hints and stale-request cancellation.

milestones.title: Native Debugger & Debug Adapter Protocol
milestones.acceptance: DAP stepping, breakpoints, stack/locals/watches and source mapping report unavailable optimized values honestly.

milestones.title: Ahead-of-Time Native Compiler
milestones.acceptance: Own AOT output links into runnable PE/ELF programs with explicit startup/runtime inclusion and ABI tests.

milestones.title: AArch64 Backend
milestones.acceptance: Own AArch64 lowering, AAPCS64 calls and relocations execute on hardware or a documented emulator.

milestones.title: WebAssembly Backend
milestones.acceptance: Wasm lowering preserves checked arithmetic, control flow, memory and runtime failures under a documented host ABI.

milestones.title: Cross-Language SDK & Runtime ABI
milestones.implemented: Versioned C ABI v1, C++ program API and .NET SafeHandle SDK; object/async ABI remains open.
milestones.acceptance: C/C++, .NET and implemented Wasm hosts share versioned object/error/lifecycle/async contracts.

milestones.title: Package Manager & Reproducible Builds
milestones.acceptance: Package resolution, lockfiles, integrity and local dependencies produce reproducible builds with controlled scripts.

milestones.title: Standard Library & Language Toolchain
milestones.acceptance: Collections/Unicode/Result/iterators/serialization/async tools include substantial MPLX implementations and real tests.

milestones.title: Multi-Engine Differential Execution
milestones.implemented: Independent AST, raw/SSA VM, arena/register native comparisons, intermediate-pass conformance and module tests.
milestones.acceptance: Every implemented backend shares one outcome/effect corpus; backend-specific resource-policy differences are explicit.

milestones.title: Grammar-Based & Metamorphic Fuzzing
milestones.implemented: Six coverage-guided harnesses, deterministic mutation corpora and scalar metamorphic tests; no general grammar generator/reducer.
milestones.acceptance: Typed grammar generation, semantic metamorphisms and automatic reduction produce small retained disagreement regressions.

milestones.title: SMT-Based Translation Validation
milestones.acceptance: SMT validation proves or produces counterexamples for a clearly delimited checked-integer CFG subset.

milestones.title: Formal Models of Runtime Invariants
milestones.acceptance: Formal and executable models cover GC reachability, tier state restoration, coroutine races, cleanup and cache invalidation.

milestones.title: Performance & Reliability Research Laboratory
milestones.implemented: Windows/Linux checks, sanitizers, retained compiler benchmarks, ABI/concurrency tests and CI matrices.
milestones.acceptance: Latency, execution, memory, code size, reliability and platform measurements are reproducible and tied to exact inputs/builds.

milestones.title: Interactive Compiler Explorer
milestones.implemented: Real IR/machine/analysis dumps and optimization trace artifacts; no interactive explorer UI.
milestones.acceptance: An interactive explorer renders actual pipeline snapshots, pass diffs, graphs and allocation without reimplementing compilation in the UI.

milestones.title: Runtime Profiler & Execution Time Machine
milestones.acceptance: Profiler events correlate calls, allocation, GC and tier activity; supported deterministic replay states its limits.

milestones.title: Ultimate Compiler Engineering Showcase
milestones.acceptance: Real multipackage programs exercise composite types, generics, concurrency, FFI and multiple targets with published correctness/performance evidence.
